content:
Amir: hi team, i'm Amir (joined platform this week). hitting a couple onboarding bumps: 1) Datadog dashboards for 'ingest-pipeline' aren't visible under our team folder, 2) my Sentry invite says 'Pending' even after i accepted, and 3) in Grafana some panels show 'No data' but the same queries work in Explore. who do i ping?
Leah: welcome Amir! open a Datadog access ticket and tag eng-infra, they can check dashboard perms. for Sentry, SSO invites sometimes require you to accept from the corporate email — did you accept from your redwood email?
Amir: accepted from my redwood email (amir@redwood.com). the invite shows accepted but in the org UI i'm still under 'Pending'.
Marta: hi Amir — i'm the observability PM. Sentry pending usually means the SSO mapping didn't finish. can you share the exact SSO email via DM? i'll escalate to identity.
Amir: DM'd you the email.
devex-bot: Quick links: Datadog onboard runbook: https://wiki.redwood.com/devex/datasvc/datadog-onboard Sentry invite troubleshooting: https://wiki.redwood.com/security/sso-invite-checklist Grafana viewer roles: https://wiki.redwood.com/devex/grafana-roles
sre-oncall: i peeked — Datadog folder permissions for team 'ingest' were missing after org rename. filing DD-ACCESS-482 and assigned to eng-infra. temporary read access granted to your account (check email).
Amir: confirmed i can see ingest-pipeline dashboards now, thanks. about Grafana 'No data' panels: i can run the same promql in Explore and get results, but dashboard panels return zero.
Leah: dashboard 'No data' often comes from template variables not being set (eg instance=~"$instance") or relative time range. click the dashboard settings -> variables and ensure defaults are set. also check the top-right time range isn't set to a custom absolute that excludes data.
Marta: another common gotcha: panels using a Loki datasource will show No data if your team doesn't have Loki query access. which datasource shows on the panel?
Amir: panels that show No data list datasource as 'Prometheus (prod)'. variables include $cluster and $env. i think $env default is empty.
Leah: if $env is empty the query becomes invalid. for now try the dashboard's variables dropdown and set env=staging or prod. if variable list is empty we probably need to re-sync template values from the dashboard JSON.
Amir: setting env=staging fixed most panels. one panel still shows No data — says "Query timeout" when i hover.
sre-oncall: that panel runs an expensive aggregation. viewers sometimes hit frontend timeouts; try the panel's inspect -> query tab to see the actual query time. if you need to debug with 30s refresh, request temporary Editor in your DD ticket and avoid wide time ranges.
Amir: inspect shows a 12s query and then timed out. i'll keep it at 5m refresh and file a follow-up in DD-ACCESS-482 asking for Editor for a 1-hour window to debug.
Marta: i'll also add a note to the dashboard README to warn about heavy panels and suggest cloning before changing refresh. happy to run a 15-min walkthrough of the main dashboards if you'd like.
Amir: that would be super helpful, thanks Marta. marking this thread as resolved for my initial access issues. appreciate the quick responses :thumbsup:
